photo.alt: True-colour satellite image of Tortola and its smaller neighbours

facts: East of Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands, north-west of Anguilla
Four main islands: Tortola, Virgin Gorda, Anegada and Jost Van Dyke
worth_knowing: More than 50 smaller islands and cays surround them, and about 16 of the islands are inhabited. Tortola, the largest, is about 20 km long and 5 km wide.
